newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa money mkt shortage falls to 8.73 bln rand.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa money mkt shortage falls to 8.73 bln rand.

text.p: South Africa's money market shortage fell further to 8.732 billion rand on Thursday from 9.444 billion rand on Wednesday, the Reserve Bank said on Friday.

Three-month NCD rates were lower at between 17.30 and 17.60 percent from 17.35 and 17.65 percent, while the 90-day BA rate also fell slightly to between 16.65 and 16.90 percent from 16.65 and 16.95 percent.
